Impact Absorption

Noumu (My Hero Academia) is able to withstand the strength from All Might's punches due to the Quirk, Shock Absorption.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb the impacts of anything.

The power to absorb mechanical and physical impacts. Sub-power of Impact Manipulation and Kinetic Energy Manipulation. Variation of Absorption. Not to be confused with Physical Force Absorption.

Contents

  • 1 Also Called
  • 2 Capabilities
  • 3 Applications
  • 4 Associations
  • 5 Limitations

Also Called[]

  • Affliction Absorption
  • Attack Absorption
  • Damage Absorption
  • Shock Absorption

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb a perfectly inelastic collision, an object struck by a projectile will deform, and this deformation will absorb most, or even all, of the force of the collision. They can absorb physical impacts such as punches and kicks, weaponry such as swords, bullets and hammers or even explosions.

Applications[]

  • Absorption
    • Kinetic Energy Absorption
  • Bulletproof Durability

Associations[]

  • Collision Inducement
  • Elasticity
  • Fat Manipulation
  • Impact Manipulation
  • Invulnerability
  • Landing Dash
  • Physical Force Absorption
  • Sponge Physiology

Limitations[]

  • May not be able to absorb multiple impacts at once.
  • May be limited to certain types of objects like blunt objects.
  • Damage that lacks any form of impact such as fire, ice, poison, or electricity can still harm the user, rendering the power virtually useless.
  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation

Gallery[]

Billy Blim (Angel) strikes the ground with enough force to crack it and absorbs the resulting impact.
Batman's (Batman: Arkham City) Battle Armored Tech Suit absorbs impact energy from combat and releases it on command.
Thanks to the Slayer Handbook, D'Hoffryn (Buffy the Vampire Slayer) can absorb the kinetic energy of impacts and redirect them.
Bergamo (Dragon Ball Super) absorbs the impact of Goku's attacks...
...and uses them to grow in size.
Botamo (Dragon Ball Super) absorbs the impact of Goku's attacks and transfers the damage to another dimension.
The Black Panther's (Marvel Comics) Panther Habit suit, being composed of Vibranium, can absorb and redirect the force of impacts, such as bullets.
Due to his rubber body, Monkey D. Luffy (One Piece) is immune to normal impacts.
Impact Dials (One Piece) can absorb kinetic energy, such as impacts, and redirect it.
Adam Taurus's (RWBY) Semblance allows him to absorb impacts with his sword...
...and unleash them as a sword beam.
Yang Xiao Long's (RWBY) Semblance works by absorbing the impacts of her enemies' attacks, increasing her strength.
SpongeBob SquarePants (SpongeBob SquarePants) absorbing the impacts of Flats' punches.
Being fat, Po (Kung Fu Panda) tends to absorb any impact that comes to him. This means not even nerve attack strikes can affect him and only cause other effects like making him feel a tickle every time it happens.
Buyoon (Sonic the Hedgehog)
Sebastian Shaw’s (X-Men: First Class) ability allows him to absorb all forms of energy, including the kinetic force of bullets and such.
Dash (Disney Mirrorverse) with his shock absorption armor.
Fatgum (Boku No Hero Academia/My Hero Academia) can store fat and any impacts that he can store in his body for later use for attacks at the cost of losing his fat for defense.
